scope.summary: Suite-wide conformance harness proving [STU-CON-007](b): for EVERY Studio mutating command, the mutation routes through the per-file CRDT document + file-scoped lease + EventLedger-idempotent promotion path (MT-013), never a direct authority write. Runs the swarm harness with N concurrent model agents issuing the SAME and DIFFERENT commands on multiple files AND on one shared file; asserts no corruption, no silent overwrite, deterministic promotion ordering, conflict surfacing, and no interference with a concurrent operator session on a different project. Fails closed on any command that mutates authority outside the CRDT+lease+promotion path.
acceptance_criteria: every mutating command CRDT+lease+idempotent-promotion routed; multi-model multi-file safe; operator-isolated; direct-write fails closed
expected_tests: swarm: N agents x multi-file + N agents x one-file concurrent edits -> no corruption, idempotent promotion, conflicts surfaced
negative: a command writing authority outside CRDT+lease+promotion fails the gate
test: concurrent operator on other project unaffected

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Parallel multi-model/multi-file editing can corrupt state; STU-CON-007(b) unenforced (the audit's biggest gap).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
